summary: Restrict credential/private files to an owner-only Windows DACL at write time, and self-heal inherited-ACL copies at read time instead of refusing them.
reason: Chmod(0600) is a DACL no-op on NTFS: AtomicWritePrivateFile produced files that VerifyCredsPerms then rejected, and copied credential files inherited broad ACEs causing every command to re-mint a token (OAuth rate-limit storm).
validated_outcome: A credentials.toml copied into a sandbox HOME (inherited foreign ACEs) loads and serves live data without re-minting; explicit broad grants still refuse
